description:
ONWARDS TOGETHER!

Illumio is the leader in ransomware and breach containment, redefining how organizations contain cyberattacks and enable operational resilience. Powered by the Illumio AI Security Graph, our breach containment platform identifies and contains threats across hybrid multi-cloud environments – stopping the spread of attacks before they become disasters.

Recognized as a Leader in the Forrester Wave™ for Microsegmentation, Illumio enables Zero Trust, strengthening cyber resilience for the infrastructure, systems, and organizations that keep the world running.


LOCATION: 5 ON-SITE DAYS A WEEK IN SUNNYVALE, CA HEADQUARTERS.

 


OUR TEAM'S VISION:

Our Engineering team is driven by a culture that thrives on visionary leadership, autonomy, and ownership, creating a dynamic synergy that drives us forward in the ever-evolving landscape of cybersecurity. 

When you join our team, you become part of the leader in Zero Trust Segmentation. You'll work with a cutting-edge technology stack that spans operating systems, distributed applications, and immersive UI/visualization tools.  

We're shaping the future of cybersecurity. And together, we will continue to build world-class products—led by people with different perspectives, backgrounds, and a commitment to innovation in a time when the world faces its greatest cybersecurity threats in history. 

 


YOUR IMPACT:

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join the CloudSecure team and help deliver enterprise-grade cloud security at scale. You'll own quality across a multi-cloud micro-segmentation platform that protects workloads on AWS, Azure, and GCP—working across the full stack from cloud synchronization and policy computation to APIs, UI, distributed services, and large-scale infrastructure.

This role goes beyond functional testing. You'll build automation, validate performance and scalability at enterprise scale, improve release confidence, and ensure the platform remains resilient under real-world production conditions.

 - Product Quality & Automation (50%)

 - Design and execute comprehensive functional, integration, and end-to-end test strategies for CloudSecure features

 - Build and maintain scalable API, UI, and end-to-end automation frameworks

 - Validate cloud security workflows including resource discovery, policy computation, flow ingestion, visualization, and compliance across AWS, Azure, and GCP

 - Partner with engineering and product teams to define acceptance criteria, improve testability, and drive shift-left quality practices

 - Own defect triage, root cause analysis, and release readiness for your feature areas

 - Quality Engineering & Infrastructure (50%)

 - Design and execute large-scale performance and scalability tests simulating enterprise customer environments

 - Thousands of workloads

 - Hundreds of VPCs/VNETs

 - Millions of flow records

 - Large policy and inventory datasets

 - Build automated performance benchmarks and regression suites to detect latency, throughput, and resource utilization regressions

 - Validate system behavior under stress, peak load, and long-running endurance scenarios

 - Design and execute chaos engineering experiments including:

 - Database failovers

 - Kafka failures and lag

 - Network partitions

 - Cloud API throttling

 - Pod failures and OOM scenarios

 - Validate graceful degradation, fault tolerance, recovery, and high availability across distributed services

 - Own quality gates within CI/CD and continuously improve automation reliability, execution time, and release confidence

 - Drive cross-module integration testing across User Console, CloudSecure services, Policy Compute Engine, and supporting platform services

 - Develop tooling that enables developers to self-serve test environments, test data, and automation execution


YOUR TOOLKIT:

 - Bachelor’s in computer science or equivalent degree. Master’s degree a plus

 - 9+ years building automation for SaaS or cloud-native distributed systems

 - Strong programming skills in Python, Go, JavaScript, or similar

 - Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Cypress, Playwright, Pytest, or equivalent

 - Experience designing automation for APIs, UI, and distributed microservices

 - Hands-on experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP, including networking and security constructs (VPCs, VNets, Security Groups, Firewalls, IAM)

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar)

 - Strong understanding of distributed systems, REST APIs, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architectures

 - Ability to debug application code and work closely with developers to identify root causes—not just report failures

Nice to Have:

 - Experience with performance and load testing tools such as k6, Locust, JMeter, or Gatling

 - Experience profiling application performance and identifying bottlenecks across distributed systems

 - Familiarity with observability platforms (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, OpenTelemetry)

 - Experience with chaos engineering tools such as Litmus, Gremlin, or Chaos Monkey

 - Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform

 - Understanding of network security, segmentation, firewall policies, and cloud networking

 - Experience testing enterprise-scale multi-tenant SaaS platforms

 

This position involves access to software/technology that is subject to U.S. export controls. Any job offer made will be contingent upon the applicant’s capacity to serve in compliance with U.S. export controls.

#LI-KD1 #LI-ONSITE

Our Commitment



Illumio believes that an environment of unique backgrounds, experiences, viewpoints, and individual contributions creates a culture of belonging, drives our future, and makes us stronger together in support of our customers and their success.



All official job offers from our company are extended directly by our recruitment team and will be sent through an official E-Signature document for your review and signature. Please be aware that we do not ask for any personal information in the process of extending offers of employment, such as financial details or social security numbers. Upon acceptance of any offer, we will request such information as part of the onboarding process prior to or on your first day of employment, and only after completing a background check through an authorized third-party vendor. If you receive any communication asking for personal details outside of these processes, please contact us immediately to verify the authenticity of the request. Your security is important to us, and we are committed to a safe and transparent hiring experience.

For roles in San Francisco and Los Angeles: Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring, Illumio will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.
